mentions.name: Genabler
mentions.description: A plugin for Autodesk Civil 3D that bundles network catalogs and collates Civil 3D styles, making standard, market-compliant catalogs and polished styles easily available to civil engineers through prominent quick-access buttons, sold for a fee as an alternative to relying on BIM modelers.
mentions.problem: The out-of-the-box catalogs and styles shipped with Civil 3D's default installation are limited and fairly well hidden, so they go unused, and engineers typically assume they need BIM modelers to create catalogs and styles and assist with their use.
mentions.source_excerpt: A Civil 3D plugin (Genabler) that will include all the network catalogs and collate the Civil 3D styles for civil engineers to use.

evidence.value: A Civil 3D plugin (Genabler) that will include all the network catalogs and collate the Civil 3D styles for civil engineers to use.
